- workflow-templates/.claude/scripts/stale_sessions.py | location: record_stalls (lines ~430-455, both copies)
  PROBLEM: When `needs_action` is exactly "Approve or deny" with no tool name, the optional regex `(?P<tool>...)` group captures `None`, and the recorded tool_name becomes the literal string `StalledSession(None)`.
  WHY: The stall is still filed and the title/task_summary evidence travels through `tool_input`, but `permission_prompts.py file` groups by tool_name, so a no-tool stall lands in a distinct group from the usual `StalledSession(Bash)` etc. This is reachable whenever the harness omits the tool name from the prompt (the regex correctly allows that).
  suggested minimal fix: Use a readable placeholder when `tool` is None, e.g. `tool_name = f"StalledSession({tool})" if tool else "StalledSession"`. Three-character edit.
  HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 1
